listings.title: Mthatha broiler and feed-grain holding
listings.summary: State-owned holding outside Mthatha released for contract broiler production with a maize block for on-farm feed. Sheds are structurally sound but need re-fitting before the first cycle.
listings.water: Borehole yield 3.2 l/s, registered for 18 000 m³/yr
listings.soil: Hutton and Avalon sandy loam, effective depth 800–1 200 mm
eligibility: South African citizen, 18 years or older, with a valid green barcoded ID or smart card
Not the registered owner of agricultural land larger than the parcel applied for
Able to show farming experience, a relevant qualification, or a mentorship agreement
One application per household; joint applications must be a registered legal entity
Tax compliant, or registered for a compliance arrangement with SARS

applicationSteps.title: Register an expression of interest
applicationSteps.detail: Submit the expression of interest form to the OR Tambo District office, in person or by email, quoting the parcel reference. Late submissions are not carried over to the next round.

applicationSteps.title: Compliance screening
applicationSteps.detail: The office checks citizenship, existing land holdings and tax status. Applicants who fail screening are notified in writing with the reason and may resubmit in the next round.

applicationSteps.title: Submit a production plan
applicationSteps.detail: Shortlisted applicants prepare a five-year production plan for the enterprise mix listed above. District extension officers in Mthatha run free planning clinics during the application window.

applicationSteps.title: District assessment panel
applicationSteps.detail: The panel scores each shortlisted applicant on experience, plan quality, own contribution and whether the enterprise suits the parcel. Scores and the ranking are recorded.

applicationSteps.title: Provincial allocation and lease signing
applicationSteps.detail: The provincial allocation committee confirms the ranked recommendation and issues the lease. Occupation follows a joint site handover and a signed asset register.

contact.office: OR Tambo District land allocation office

listings.summary: Irrigated block on a revitalised government scheme near Robertson. Allocation is per-plot; applicants may apply for one plot only and must farm it themselves.
listings.water: Scheme allocation of 6 000 m³/ha/yr from the district water user association
listings.soil: Alluvial Oakleaf, high water-holding capacity, pH 6.1–6.8
infrastructure: Pump station and 2 km buried mainline
eligibility: South African citizen, 18 years or older, with a valid green barcoded ID or smart card
Not the registered owner of agricultural land larger than the parcel applied for
Able to show farming experience, a relevant qualification, or a mentorship agreement
One application per household; joint applications must be a registered legal entity
Tax compliant, or registered for a compliance arrangement with SARS

applicationSteps.title: Register an expression of interest
applicationSteps.detail: Submit the expression of interest form to the Cape Winelands District office, in person or by email, quoting the parcel reference. Late submissions are not carried over to the next round.

applicationSteps.title: Compliance screening
applicationSteps.detail: The office checks citizenship, existing land holdings and tax status. Applicants who fail screening are notified in writing with the reason and may resubmit in the next round.

applicationSteps.title: Submit a production plan
applicationSteps.detail: Shortlisted applicants prepare a five-year production plan for the enterprise mix listed above. District extension officers in Robertson run free planning clinics during the application window.

applicationSteps.title: District assessment panel
applicationSteps.detail: The panel scores each shortlisted applicant on experience, plan quality, own contribution and whether the enterprise suits the parcel. Scores and the ranking are recorded.

applicationSteps.title: Provincial allocation and lease signing
applicationSteps.detail: The provincial allocation committee confirms the ranked recommendation and issues the lease. Occupation follows a joint site handover and a signed asset register.
